primary_claim: Giving the Petri auditor access to real deployment resources (system prompts, tool definitions, codebases) increases average realism win rate for agentic coding reward hacking audits from 4.6% to 32.8%, without significantly changing the target model's reward hacking rate.

effect.metric: realism win rate (% of pairwise comparisons where LLM judge picks the audit transcript as more realistic than a deployment transcript)
effect.value: 4.6% to 32.8% average across 5 reward hacking scenarios; shutdown-resistance scenario stayed near 0% with resources alone, improving to 19.3% only after rewriting the seed

depends_on: post: It's hard to make scheming evals look realistic for LLMs (Ivanov and Kadochnikov)
aisi.gov.uk blog (Souly et al., task-driven eval-awareness)
post: Claude Sonnet 3.7 often knows when it's in alignment evaluations (Goldowsky-Dill et al.)
contradicts_or_qualifies: Qualifies prior realism metrics (verbalized eval-awareness rate, post-hoc realism rating) as coarser and susceptible to false positives in deployment; extends Souly et al.'s finding of task-driven eval-awareness to show it persists even with improved environment realism
stated_future_work: Investigate how realism affects target behavior further; results might vary by target model, task, and realism thresholds
Improve realism of chat-focused / sycophancy audits where user-prompt realism is the bottleneck
Give auditors better search tools so users don't need to manually curate resource repositories
limitations_stated: Focus is on agentic coding scenarios, only a small slice of deployment contexts
Negative results found improving chat-focused audits (companion post)
Realism win rate is highly dependent on deployment data, which comes from narrow subsets (25-30 transcripts) of the deployment distribution
Only a small set of auditor, target, and judge models were tested
quote: Providing these resources to the auditor increases the average realism win rate from 4.6% to 32.8% for reward hacking audits, and doesn't significantly change hack rate.
